rows.reason: Six family guarantees were read for what each promises. FAM-B7GVSN: a failed review selects the configured step-up under fieldwise precedence and its durable transition keeps exact retry identity without resetting either lane. FAM-Q5J2ZC: every route that creates, lands, judges or closes a task carrying the removed mode refuses it by the same name with the same reason and the known way out, the escape being abandon plus a modeless restart. FAM-83BTBD: a leaf's three seats hand each other the exact freeze, sealed verdict, producer list, memory candidate or code concern directly, and the Manager relays none of a hand-over's contents. FAM-14NZRC: one qualified server entry and one browser task map, native document stage taking precedence, bound host observations supplying only started-task activity and event time, and ordered membership served once per declaring master. FAM-V8AH28: a tool call completed on the host path lands one bounded facts-only workspace-river row attributed to its caller, with failed writes counted. FAM-TG3WK0: the reader protocol and tool-sweep waits each end at a limit, and the sweep's limit is a named failure. None promises what this invariant does: that a launch's preflight over an artifact written beside its report refuses a non-regular target with the caller's own words before the three sibling publications and the native create, so no family takes it as a member.
